from collections import Counter
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); j=None
    # divider: full uniform line whose color differs from adjacent blocks
    for j in range(1,W-1):
        if len({I[r][j] for r in range(H)})==1:
            c=I[0][j]
            if j>0 and I[0][j-1]!=c and j<W-2 and I[0][j+1]!=c:
                pass
    # pick divider with unique neighbor-color property
    cands=[j for j in range(W) if len({I[r][j] for r in range(H)})==1]
    def bgg(M): return Counter(x for r_ in M for x in r_).most_common()[0][0]
    results=[]
    for j in cands:
        c=I[0][j]
        L=Counter(I[r][j-1] for r in range(H)).most_common()[0][0]
        R=Counter(I[r][j+1] for r in range(H)).most_common()[0][0]
        if c!=L and c!=R:
            A=[[I[r][k] for k in range(j)] for r in range(H)]
            B=[[I[r][j+1+k] for k in range(W-j-1)] for r in range(H)]
            nA=bgg(A); nB=bgg(B)
            Ma=[[x!=nA for x in r] for r in A]; Nb=[[x!=nB for x in r] for r in B]
            pred=[[2 if (Ma[i][k] and Nb[i][k]) else 0 for k in range(len(Nb[0]))] for i in range(H)]
            results.append(pred)
    return results
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    res=solve(G[n+' input']); O=G[n+' output']
    print(n, [r==O for r in res])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])[0]))

from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    # vertical divider
    for j in range(1,W-1):
        if len({I[r][j] for r in range(H)})==1:
            c=I[0][j]
            L=Counter(I[r][j-1] for r in range(H))
            R=Counter(I[r][j+1] for r in range(H))
            if c!=L.most_common(1)[0][0] and c!=R.most_common(1)[0][0]:
                A=[[I[r][k] for k in range(j)] for r in range(H)]; B=[[I[r][j+1+k] for k in range(W-j-1)] for r in range(H)]
                nA=L.most_common(1)[0][0]; nB=R.most_common(1)[0][0]
                Ma=[[x!=nA for x in r] for r in A]; Nb=[[x!=nB for x in r] for r in B]
                return [[2 if (Ma[i][k] and Nb[i][k]) else 0 for k in range(len(Nb[0]))] for i in range(H)]
    # horizontal divider
    for i in range(1,H-1):
        if len({I[i][c] for c in range(W)})==1:
            c=I[i][0]
            U=Counter(I[i-1][c] for c in range(W)).most_common(1)[0][0]
            D=Counter(I[i+1][c] for c in range(W)).most_common(1)[0][0]

        else:
            A=[[I[r][k] for k in range(W)] for r in range(s)]
